Game Overview

In Move Square, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a bold square through a tricky maze, making sharp turns to avoid pitfalls. With each tap, your timing is tested as obstacles grow tougher. Stay agile and watch your score soar in this fast-paced survival challenge that demands focus and precision.
